main:1.text: After Francis Drake's coffin was recovered from the ocean floor, Elena filmed the discovery for her reality show. As Nate began prying open the lid, Elena questioned the ethics of "defiling" his ancestor's remains, also adding that her research confirmed that Sir Francis had no children. Nate argued otherwise, also claiming there would be no corpse.

main:2.text: Following the map in Francis Drake's diary, Nate and Victor trekked through the jungle until they reached a large clearing. Contrary to the diary's coordinates, they found no city, much to Victor's disappointment. While investigating further, they discovered the entrance to an ancient temple. After a series of climbs, Nate reached an elevated vantage point and noticed a hollow section of the ground.

main:3.text: After climbing around the surrounding cliffs, Nate found a way into the U-boat. Inside, he saw signs of a violent struggle, noting blood and debris scattered throughout the interior. Exploring further, he found a rotting corpse with pockets full of Spanish gold coins stamped with an unfamiliar mint mark, suggesting the Germans were harboring a significant secret.

main:4.text: After jumping from the plane with a faulty parachute, Nate awakened while dangling from a tree branch, startled by the sight of a sword-wielding angel statue. After cutting himself loose, he discovered that he had left the map on the plane, which had crashed deep in the forest. He proceeded to venture across the island toward the distant column of smoke rising from the wreckage.

main:5.text: In Drake's Fortune Remastered, completing the chapter in less than 10 minutes unlocks the silver trophy "These Walls Can't Stop Me". Lacking a conventional entrance, Nate scaled the fortress's exterior walls. Once inside, he encountered several groups of pirates. After clearing the initial courtyard, Nate continued his search for Elena, heading toward the ruined tower where she had originally landed.

main:6.text: Nate exited the flooded chambers of the fort into a courtyard and spotted a prominent tower. Noticing that the tower matched a sketch on the map recovered from the U-boat, Nate decided to investigate. After defeating several pirates, he discovered a locked door marked with an emblem of two keys. He recovered the tower keys and used them to push deeper into the fortress.

main:7.text: After Elena freed Nate from his cell, Eddy's pirates pursued the two in a chase that led them across the island. While Elena controlled the wheel, Nate manned a machine gun to keep the pirates off their tail. Once they had evaded the last of their pursuers, the two reached a dead-end where Elena nearly drove the jeep over a cliff. Nate was thrown from his seat but managed to cling to the back of the vehicle.

main:8.text: Nate and Elena swam from their submerged jeep into the flooded ruins of an abandoned settlement. After defeating the remaining pirates in the area, Elena showed Nate footage she had captured at the fortress. She identified a building in the harbor used for unloading cargo and surmised that the El Dorado statue must have passed through that facility.

main:9.text: After navigating further through the flooded ruins, Nate and Elena reached a drop-off point. Nate proceeded alone to reach the tower while Elena returned to the customs house, intending to meet him there. Following several skirmishes with Eddy Raja's pirates, Nate reached the summit of the tower. He used a cable as a makeshift zipline to slide through a hole in the customs house roof.

main:10.text: Shortly after reuniting, Nate and Elena entered a room containing old ship manifests. While investigating, Nate discovered a logbook detailing the Esperanza, a vessel that had sailed from Callao, Peru, carrying a gold statue weighing 20 arrobas (500 pounds). On the final page, Nate found a detailed illustration of El Dorado. Observing Nate handling his necklace, Elena asked if it held personal significance.

main:11.text: Upon returning to the customs house interior, Nate noticed a helicopter flying by, noting that it did not belong to Eddy's crew. As Nate descended the stairs into the room, he was ambushed by waves of pirates. After surviving, he advanced toward the harbor to reach the motorboat. When he reached the harbor, Nate spotted pirates loading supplies onto the boat and preparing to depart.

main:12.text: Completing the chapter in under 5 minutes in Drake's Fortune Remastered unlocks the bronze trophy Up a Short Creek Without a Paddle. Nate and Elena reached the river and boarded a jet ski to drive upriver in search of Victor. Along the way, they had to navigate waterfalls, avoid rocks and floating explosive barrels, and fend off persistent attacks from Eddy Raja's pirates.

main:13.text: Nate and Elena arrived at the monastery and engaged a small group of pirates. Shortly after, they discovered the body of one of Eddy Raja's pirates impaled on a spike trap. Elena initially speculated that the traps were ancient Spanish defenses; however, Nate noted that the spikes were constructed from parts of their wrecked plane, indicating they were made recently by an unknown party.

main:14.text: After Nate and his allies discovered the "land of the dead", Nate insisted on exploring the depths alone. His journey led him into the monastery chapel, which was heavily patrolled by Atoq Navarro's mercenaries. Following a heated gunfight, Nate noticed two large bells situated on opposite sides of the room.

main:15.page: On the Trail of the Treasure
main:15.text: After a brief skirmish with Atoq Navarro's mercenaries, Nate struggled to navigate the monastery grounds until Victor informed him of a secret gallery located at the top of the church. Following an extensive climb, Nate reached the sanctuary's upper levels. To access the gallery, he navigated several precarious platforms and activated two key-shaped switches.

main:16.text: Completing the chapter in less than 7 minutes in Drake's Fortune Remastered will unlock the gold trophy A Speedy Reunion. Nate and Elena entered the vault, which consisted of a vast labyrinth of walkways and stairs. Nate noticed several Roman numerals engraved into metal plates set into the ground and walls, each accompanied by a directional arrow.

main:17.text: Nate and Elena began searching for an exit from the vault. After Nate spotted machinery high above the room, he gave Elena a boost up to a broken ladder. She ascended to the upper section and located a rope attached to an old hoist near an escape tunnel. As she attempted to move the hoist, Eddy Raja and Prakoso backed into the room, clearly terrified.

main:18.text: To restore power to the facility, Nate proceeded alone, navigating a series of exterior pipes to find an entry point. Once inside, Sully attempted to contact him via walkie-talkie, though Nate was unable to establish a stable signal. As Nate explored the bunker, he noted the extensive damage to the interior and questioned what had occurred there.

main:19.text: Once Nate activated the generator, an alarm triggered and descendants immediately swarmed the room. To unlock the exit, he had to activate two electrical switches to restore power to the rest of the bunker while fending off the creatures. After escaping the generator room, Nate retraced his steps through the facility.

main:20.text: After fleeing from the bunker, Nate contacted Victor via walkie-talkie to inform him of Elena's capture. Victor, however, was pinned down by Atoq Navarro's mercenaries in the monastery courtyard. Nate arrived to assist his partner, helping him neutralize the hostile forces.

main:21.text: After discovering a secret passage beneath the altar, Nate and Sully navigated the catacombs and emerged into a massive open cavern. There, they set eyes on the El Dorado statue. Attempting to maintain the element of surprise, the two prepared to intervene, but they were quickly intercepted by two of Navarro's mercenaries brandishing shotguns.

main:22.text: Completing the chapter without dying on Normal difficulty or harder in Drake's Fortune Remastered unlocks the bronze trophy "YOLO Fortunately". Armed with a SAS - 12 shotgun, Nate fought through waves of Navarro's mercenaries while Navarro attempted to suppress him with the same shotgun with a laser attached. After several shootouts, Nate pursued Navarro to the helipad where the helicopter had crashed.
